candidate_signature: Eval_D,C : Expr_D x Context_C -> Option[Expr_C x Residue_D,C]
preservation_predicate: Pres_D,C(x,y) iff representable_distinction_C(Pi_D,C(x),Pi_D,C(y)) preserves the declared distinction relation
noncollapse_boundary: Collapse_D,C(x) iff Pi_D,C(x) is undefined or the required distinction is not representable in C
